exactTerms: Create only a separate hypothetical PG328-W09-R1 successor branch by copying W01-403 terminal S030 at t=12.9 exactly. Keep every historical parent byte, W01/other witness branch, prior seal, the W01 south panel at 55 HP, all actor resources, the Fortress object, item custody and tile expiry unchanged at branch start.

Use only Geometry405, SupportOverlay425 and OwnerAdoption424 within their stated W01/test-only scope. The branch may move A along the exact source-bound axis-aligned clear route from [25,6,0] through [25,11,0], [25,10,0], [55,10,0], [55,35,0], [55,45,0], [55,55,0], [45,55,0], and the keep-flight-0 positions through [45,59.5,4.5]. Reverse traversal of the verified 403-A-movement segment is an explicit branch premise.

After A’s regular START at18.0 and before movement, at18.01 A spends the turn’s one ordinary free object interaction to reposition the same right-held clay tile. Preserve the exact inherited bounds until this event. First translate the tile horizontally to [27,28]×[7,8]×[0,0.25], then raise it to [27,28]×[7,8]×[3,3.25]. These are ordered submotions of one interaction, not additional turns or movement grants. Thereafter use Geometry405’s relative carry bounds [2,3]×[1,2]×[3,3.25] through travel and falling. Each attack moves it to the stated strike bounds and returns it to this carry pose. Preserve identity, right-hand custody, dimensions, mass, Load, original expiry and all other resources. Record the interaction expenditure and reversible bounds transition; inverse traversal restores the exact parent.

For this branch only, count the absolute displacement of each axis-aligned route segment, including its vertical coordinate, as movement cost. The exact route totals 100 feet: 6 + 55 + 10 + 20 + 9. A spends ordinary 30-foot movement at regular starts t=18,24,30,36; it uses no Dash, receives no extra movement, and reaches the attack pose after 30+30+30+10 feet. Static clearance is not a claim that traversal already occurred.

At the attack pose A occupies [45,50]Ã—[59.5,64.5]Ã—[4.5,10.5]. For this W09 branch only, a creature is supported by a structural surface only through positive-area upward-facing bottom contact: its foot plane must equal the contacted structural part top and horizontal footprints must overlap. Side contact with a wall, including keep-west-60-5, cannot support a creature. At this pose Aâ€™s only bottom-contact supports are keep-tread-0-9 and keep-riser-0-9; both are supported before the target damage and both lose their rooted path when the named target is destroyed.

For each ordinary Attack/Sunder, A may wield the same 1Ã—1Ã—0.25-foot clay tile while it stays held in A:right. The branch-specific strike contact pose is [45,46]Ã—[60,61]Ã—[4.75,5.0]: the tile touches the targetâ€™s east face at x=45 over 1Ã—0.25 square feet, with no positive-volume penetration. The swing is part of the ordinary Attack Action; it costs no separate movement or Action, consumes no tile, creates no new tile, and returns to the corrected Geometry405 carry pose defined in exactTerms/1 after the attack. This exact contact pose is a TEST_ONLY choice, not inherited geometry or a general reach rule.

After movement, A makes exactly 12 ordinary Attack/Sunder Actions against keep-west-60-0, one on each regular A turn beginning at t=36.1 and then every six seconds through t=102.1. For each hit the TEST_ONLY roll inputs are d20=16, STR modifier +1, proficiency +0, total 17 against AC17; damage d4=4 plus STR +1 for 5 bludgeoning. Each attack consumes Aâ€™s one ordinary Action and 0 RP; no additional spell is cast, no other Action or Bonus Action is invented, and the clay tile is not consumed. These are stipulated witness inputs, not actual rolls.

Process every actual regular initiative start/end marker for A, B, C and D from t=12.9 through the W09 fall marker. Aâ€™s travel and attacks are the only authored choices; B/C/D take no rescue, movement, attack, spell, reaction, rest, recovery or clock-reset action. No actor receives an extra turn or resource refresh beyond the source schedule.

On the twelfth hit, set only keep-west-60-0 to 0 HP and apply the source Q27 structural-collapse consequence: destroy only the 18 disconnected treads/risers enumerated in the preflight; retain origin-ground-face, the keep entrance, all other rooted parts, the Fortress itself and the historical W01 south panel. This is structural collapse only and does not invoke whole-source evacuation or termination.

A loses bottom support immediately when the dependent treads/risers are destroyed and enters the existing Falling procedure. No flight, hold, rescue, or other support effect intervenes. Begin descent at the end of Aâ€™s next regular slot in the following round, after processing all regular markers through that time. Hold x/y fixed. The first actual supporting surface is keep-tread-0-1 at z=0.5 feet (with the co-level riser edge); A lands at feet z=0.5 after 4.0 feet of uncontrolled descent. Under the bound Falling procedure, this is less than 20 feet and causes 0 damage and no damage-triggered Prone state.
